name: Socrates
summary: Detail-oriented Network Administrator with over 5 years of experience in managing and supporting enterprise networks. Proven ability to troubleshoot and optimize network performance while ensuring high levels of security and reliability.

description: Manage a team of 4 in maintaining and monitoring the corporate network.
Implemented new network security protocols that reduced breaches by 40%.
Conduct daily system performance monitoring and initiate improvements.
Assisted in the design and implementation of new network infrastructures.
Supported troubleshooting efforts in hardware and software issues.
Maintained documentation for network configurations and procedures.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Led a project to upgrade network hardware resulting in a 30% performance improvement.
Developed a network migration strategy involving cloud solutions.
